question: 设 $A$ 为 $3$ 阶矩阵，$P$ 为 $3$ 阶可逆矩阵，且 $P^{-1}AP = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 \end{pmatrix}$。若 $P = (\alpha_1,\alpha_2,\alpha_3)$，$Q = (\alpha_1 + \alpha_2,\alpha_2,\alpha_3)$，则 $Q^{-1}AQ =$ $(A)$ $\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}$ $(B)$ $\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 \end{pmatrix}$ $(C)$ $\begin{pmatrix} 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 \end{pmatrix}$ $(D)$ $\begin{pmatrix} 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}$
